title: E-FRC-0253: the even second-order residue between two neutral lumps is van der Waals, not gravity, fail on V3 alone...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0253 in the gauge arena: the even second-order residue between two neutral lumps is van der Waals, not gravity, fail on V3 alone: two two-level love-fear lumps on the husk x axis reading the light's static Coulomb form (D 32, tunneling 2 pi / 1024, non-retarded) attract charge-blind by -1.96e-7 at r = 4 falling to -1.04e-10 at r = 12, as $r^{-6.49}$ over r = 6 .. 12 (London's $r^{-6}$ with higher multipoles; second order -K^2 / (4 t) at 0.94 of it by r = 12), where fixed lumps give exactly 0; the odd first-order quadrupole term f1 f2 a(r), about $r^{-5.3}$, is 56 to 312 times larger, so like lumps repel and a lump and its flipped copy attract; degenerate lumps (no tunneling) orient and attract as $r^{-3.41}$; no charge-blind 1/r term.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
